text: 1. The Photocopy of Passport (photo page and China visa page)2. The Certified/Notarized Copy of High School Transcripts (Chinese or English version)3. The Certified/Notarized Copy of High School Diploma (Chinese or English version)4. The Valid Report of Chinese or English Language Proficiency Tests. (For Chinese Medium: HSK5≥180, For English Medium: IELTS≥6.0 or TOEFL≥85 or other language certificate recognized by BIT. English native speakers are exempted.)5. Personal Statement/Study Plan (download the template from the Link, upload it in the application system after filling out)6. BIT Freshmen Scholarship Application Form (For applicants who will apply for BIT Freshmen Scholarship, please download the form from the Link, and upload it in the attachment after filling out)7. Applications under 18 must upload all materials required in Application Materials for Student under 18 8. Physical Examination Record for Foreigner (please go to hospital for a physical examination as required in Physical Examination Record for Foreigner from the Link and upload it in the application system)9. Financial Guarantee Letter (The certificate of bank saving)10. Non-criminal Record (Issued by the local police station)11. Other documents (Students in design major should provide no less than 2 art works)
